name: Return file paths from tools to messages
description:
1. The user clarified that when referring to "tools," they are not discussing the toolset that can be invoked with "tool_calls."
2. Instructions were provided to include the file name after the code block extension when creating file content.
3. There was a requirement to return the file path when using project_search or read_file tools, and to add the ChatMessage to the messages collection.
4. Suggestions were requested for changes in chat completion methods and tool implementations to manage responses with tool_calls.
5. The user asked for a method to generate new messages from tool_call responses and pass them back to the AI for further processing.

messages.content:
When AI chat calls project_search or read_file tool we must return the file path among the response.
Tools will return a ChatMessage and completions will add this ChatMessage to the messages collection. Suggest changes in the chat completion methods and tools implementations for this.

Important, when reading tools_call remember it's an array so we must manage all tool calls in the AI response.
Suggest changes on how to manage responses with tool_calls. I'd like all responses to generate new messages to be added to current chat conversation and pass them  again back to AI
